caption:
बॉलीवुड निर्देशक निखिल आडवाणी का धर्मशाला में हुआ एक ज़बरदस्त फैनबॉय मोमेंट! 🤩

मैकलोडगंज में चल रहे 15वें धर्मशाला इंटरनेशनल फिल्म फेस्टिवल 2026 के दौरान निखिल आडवाणी की मुलाकात हॉलीवुड दिग्गज रिचर्ड गेयर से हुई।

निखिल ने रिचर्ड गेयर को अपनी 2003 की ब्लॉकबस्टर फिल्म 'कल हो ना हो' का आइकॉनिक Pretty Woman सॉन्ग सीक्वेंस दिखाया, जिसमें शाहरुख़ खान टैक्सी के ऊपर डांस करते दिखते हैं। 🎬

इंस्टाग्राम पर अपनी ख़ुशी जताते हुए निखिल ने लिखा कि यह उनके लिए बहुत बड़ा फैनबॉय मोमेंट था और साथ ही लिखा "(wait for his reaction)"। निखिल ने इस पोस्ट में शाहरुख़ खान, प्रीति जिंटा, करण जौहर और शंकर-एहसान-लॉय को भी टैग किया। 🎵

बता दें कि 1990 की रिचर्ड गेयर की फिल्म Pretty Woman के मूल गाने के राइट्स करण जौहर ने खरीदे थे, जिसे बॉलीवुड स्टाइल में रिक्रिएट किया गया था।

क्या शाहरुख़ खान का यह Pretty Woman सॉन्ग आज भी आपका ऑल-टाइम फेवरेट है? हमें कमेंट्स में बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Nikkhil Advani has a fanboy moment with Richard Gere as he shows Pretty Woman star Shah Rukh Khan's iconic Kal Ho Naa Ho song
ctx.summary: The filmmaker met Hollywood actor at the 15th edition of Dharamshala International Film Festival 2026 and showed him the popular Pretty Woman sequence.
ctx.text:
Nikkhil Advani got a rather special opportunity to revisit one of the most memorable moments from his first film, and this time, he had a very special audience. The filmmaker met Hollywood actor Richard Gere at the 15th edition of Dharamshala International Film Festival 2026 and showed him the popular Pretty Woman sequence from his 2003 film Kal Ho Naa Ho, starring Shah Rukh Khan and Preity Zinta. For someone who grew up admiring the Hollywood star, it was clearly a moment to cherish.
Sharing the experience on Instagram, Nikkhil couldn't hide his excitement. He wrote, "Huge huge fan boy moment. Showed @richardgere #PrettyWoman from #KalHoNaaHo 🙌🙌🙌🙌" He further teased his followers with "(wait for his reaction)" and added "Icing on the cake 🎂".
The filmmaker also tagged Shah Rukh Khan, Preity Zinta, Karan Johar, Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy, lyricist Javed Akhtar and choreographer Farah Khan. He also tagged the official account of the late Roy Orbison in his post.
Richard Gere's 1990 romantic comedy Pretty Woman remains one of Hollywood's best-known love stories. The actor played Edward Lewis, a wealthy businessman who meets Vivian Ward (Julia Roberts), a Hollywood sex worker. What begins as an arrangement for business events soon develops into an unexpected romance. The film became a worldwide hit and helped establish Julia Roberts as a leading Hollywood star. Roy Orbison's ‘Oh, Pretty Woman’, which featured in the film, also became a timeless favourite.
The song eventually found its way into Hindi cinema through Kal Ho Naa Ho. In the film, Shah Rukh's character Aman breaks into a Hindi version of Pretty Woman, dancing on top of a taxi and trying to win over his neighbour Naina (Preity Zinta). The sequence is among the film's most recognisable moments and remains a fan favourite.
Karan Johar, who wrote the film, had acquired the rights to recreate Roy Orbison's original track. Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy worked on the music, with singer Ravi "Rags" Khote lending his voice to the Hindi version. The team gave the familiar song a Bollywood makeover without losing the charm of the original. Shah Rukh's playful performance made it even more memorable.
Released in 2003, Kal Ho Naa Ho followed Naina (Preity Zinta), a young woman in New York who is dealing with family problems and the pressures of everyday life. Things begin to change when Aman (Shah Rukh Khan) moves into her neighbourhood. His cheerful nature brings a fresh perspective to Naina's life, even as she struggles to understand his constant optimism.
Aman also tries to bring Naina closer to her best friend Rohit (Saif Ali Khan), hoping the two will find happiness together. But there is a reason behind his efforts to make everyone around him smile. Aman is terminally ill and knows he does not have much time left. Rather than let his illness define his final days, he chooses to make the most of the time he has and ensure that Naina has a happy future.
The 15th edition of the Dharmshala International Film Festival (DIFF) is being held in McLeod Ganj, Dharamshala, from October 29 to November 1, 2026. This year's festival brings together an eclectic selection of films, along with interactive sessions that give audiences an opportunity to hear directly from filmmakers and other industry professionals. Richard Gere is also part of the festival's board of advisors.
One of the sessions features filmmaker Sudhir Mishra in conversation with Nikkhil Advani. The 90-minute discussion brings together two directors with a shared history, as Advani began his career in 1996 by writing for Mishra's film Is Raat Ki Subah Nahin.
